note: To plan or show the details or route of something, often on a map or diagram.

senses.m: To plan or show the details or route of something, often on a map or diagram
senses.pat: map out a route · map out a plan · map something out carefully
ex: They mapped out the hiking route before setting off.
Họ vạch tuyến đường đi bộ trên bản đồ trước khi khởi hành.
The manager mapped out the next phase of the project.
Người quản lý phác thảo giai đoạn tiếp theo của dự án.

note: A US-funded European recovery program after World War II, formally the European Recovery Program; named after George C. Marshall. Capitalize the proper name.

senses.m: A US-funded European recovery program after World War II, formally the European Recovery Program
senses.pat: the Marshall Plan aid · launch the Marshall Plan · Marshall Plan funds
ex: The Marshall Plan helped finance postwar recovery in Europe.
Kế hoạch Marshall góp phần tài trợ công cuộc tái thiết châu Âu sau chiến tranh.
The historian examined the political aims of the Marshall Plan.
Nhà sử học xem xét mục tiêu chính trị của Kế hoạch Marshall.

note: Temporary military control of civilian government or legal processes during an emergency; declaration and limits depend on a country’s law.

senses.m: Temporary military control of civilian government or legal processes during an emergency
senses.pat: declare/impose martial law · under martial law · lift martial law
ex: The government declared martial law after the coup.
Chính phủ ban bố thiết quân luật sau cuộc đảo chính.
The constitution sets limits on martial law.
Hiến pháp đặt ra giới hạn đối với thiết quân luật.

note: A postgraduate academic degree, abbreviated MA or M.A.; requirements and naming conventions differ among universities and countries.

senses.m: A postgraduate academic degree, abbreviated MA or M
senses.pat: earn/receive a Master of Arts · a Master of Arts in history · MA degree
ex: She earned a Master of Arts in linguistics.
Cô nhận bằng thạc sĩ nghệ thuật chuyên ngành ngôn ngữ học.
The program awards a Master of Arts after two years of study.
Chương trình cấp bằng thạc sĩ nghệ thuật sau hai năm học.

note: A ticket or card entitling someone to meals; figuratively, a source of income or livelihood, sometimes implying dependence.

senses.m: A ticket or card entitling someone to meals
senses.pat: a weekly meal ticket · be someone’s meal ticket · rely on a meal ticket
ex: The factory issued meal tickets to its workers.
Nhà máy phát phiếu ăn cho công nhân.
The contract became the small studio’s meal ticket.
Hợp đồng trở thành nguồn thu sống còn của xưởng phim nhỏ.

note: To give or separate a particular amount of something by measuring it.

senses.m: To give or separate a particular amount of something by measuring it
senses.pat: measure out a dose · measure out flour · carefully measure something out
ex: Measure out two teaspoons of sugar.
Đong hai thìa cà phê đường.
The nurse measured out the medicine according to the label.
Y tá đong thuốc theo hướng dẫn trên nhãn.

note: An estimate of a person’s cognitive performance expressed as the age level at which a test score is typical; the concept is limited and can be stigmatizing if applied casually.

senses.m: An estimate of a person’s cognitive performance expressed as the age level at which a test score is typical
senses.pat: a mental age of · assess mental age · mental-age score
ex: The report cautioned that a mental-age score does not describe the whole person.
Báo cáo lưu ý rằng điểm tuổi trí tuệ không thể mô tả toàn diện một người.
Modern assessments use multiple measures rather than relying on mental age alone.
Các đánh giá hiện đại dùng nhiều phép đo thay vì chỉ dựa vào tuổi trí tuệ.

note: A non-technical and often emotionally charged term for intentionally ending a person’s life to relieve suffering; legal distinctions among euthanasia, assisted dying, and murder vary widely. Prefer precise, jurisdiction-specific terminology.

senses.m: A non-technical and often emotionally charged term for intentionally ending a person’s life to relieve suffering
senses.pat: describe something as a mercy killing · debate mercy killing · the term mercy killing
ex: The article notes that “mercy killing” is not a precise legal term.
Bài báo lưu ý “cái chết vì lòng thương” không phải thuật ngữ pháp lý chính xác.
The court considered the case under the country’s assisted-dying law.
Tòa xem xét vụ việc theo luật hỗ trợ qua đời của quốc gia đó.

note: A set of portable utensils and containers used by a soldier or camper for eating and cooking.

senses.m: A set of portable utensils and containers used by a soldier or camper for eating and cooking
senses.pat: a military mess kit · pack a mess kit · clean the mess kit
ex: Each recruit received a metal mess kit.
Mỗi tân binh được cấp một bộ đồ ăn dã chiến bằng kim loại.
He packed a mess kit for the overnight hike.
Anh mang bộ đồ ăn dã ngoại cho chuyến đi bộ qua đêm.

note: The air-filled part of the ear between the eardrum and inner ear, containing the ossicles that transmit sound.

senses.m: The air-filled part of the ear between the eardrum and inner ear, containing the ossicles that transmit sound
senses.pat: middle-ear infection · fluid in the middle ear · middle-ear pressure
ex: The infection caused fluid to build up in the middle ear.
Nhiễm trùng khiến dịch tích tụ trong tai giữa.
The middle ear transfers vibrations toward the inner ear.
Tai giữa truyền rung động đến tai trong.

note: Milk with most of its water removed, sold as a powder to be reconstituted or used in food; also called powdered milk.

senses.m: Milk with most of its water removed, sold as a powder to be reconstituted or used in food
senses.pat: reconstitute milk powder · skimmed milk powder · add milk powder to
ex: The recipe uses milk powder instead of fresh milk.
Công thức dùng sữa bột thay cho sữa tươi.
Store the opened milk powder in an airtight container.
Bảo quản sữa bột đã mở trong hộp kín khí.

note: One of the first temporary teeth in a child; British English. US English usually says baby tooth.

senses.m: One of the first temporary teeth in a child
senses.pat: lose a milk tooth · a loose milk tooth · milk teeth fall out
ex: Her first milk tooth fell out at school.
Chiếc răng sữa đầu tiên của cô bé rụng ở trường.
Children usually lose their milk teeth gradually.
Trẻ em thường rụng răng sữa dần dần.

note: A medieval religious drama about a miracle or the life of a saint; distinct from a mystery play, which dramatizes biblical stories.

senses.m: A medieval religious drama about a miracle or the life of a saint
senses.pat: a medieval miracle play · perform a miracle play · miracle-play tradition
ex: The festival staged a medieval miracle play.
Lễ hội dàn dựng một vở kịch phép lạ thời Trung cổ.
The scholar compared miracle plays with mystery plays.
Học giả so sánh kịch phép lạ với kịch huyền nhiệm.

note: A hypothetical or formerly sought transitional form in evolution; figuratively, a missing piece needed to complete an explanation or system. The term can oversimplify evolutionary change.

senses.m: A hypothetical or formerly sought transitional form in evolution
senses.pat: the missing link between · find the missing link · a crucial missing link
ex: The fossil was once described as a missing link between species.
Hóa thạch từng được mô tả là mắt xích còn thiếu giữa các loài.
The new data supplied a missing link in the investigation.
Dữ liệu mới bổ sung mắt xích còn thiếu trong cuộc điều tra.

note: An economic system combining private enterprise with government ownership, regulation, or provision of services; the balance varies by country.

senses.m: An economic system combining private enterprise with government ownership, regulation, or provision of services
senses.pat: a mixed economy combines · move toward a mixed economy · mixed-economy model
ex: The country developed a mixed economy with public and private sectors.
Quốc gia phát triển nền kinh tế hỗn hợp gồm khu vực công và tư.
Most modern economies contain elements of a mixed economy.
Hầu hết nền kinh tế hiện đại đều có yếu tố kinh tế hỗn hợp.

note: A close-fitting, often frilled cap historically worn indoors by women; now mainly appears in historical costume or descriptions.

senses.m: A close-fitting, often frilled cap historically worn indoors by women
senses.pat: wear a mob cap · a white linen mob cap · mob-cap costume
ex: The actor wore a mob cap for the period drama.
Diễn viên đội mũ vải kiểu xưa cho phim chính kịch lịch sử.
The painting shows a woman in a linen mob cap.
Bức tranh mô tả một phụ nữ đội mũ vải lanh kiểu xưa.

note: A portable telephone that connects through a cellular network; British English. US English usually says cell phone or cellphone.

senses.m: A portable telephone that connects through a cellular network
senses.pat: use/call on a mobile phone · mobile-phone number · mobile phone network
ex: She called me on her mobile phone.
Cô gọi cho tôi bằng điện thoại di động.
The mobile phone lost its signal inside the tunnel.
Điện thoại di động mất sóng bên trong đường hầm.

note: Dishonest, suspicious, or silly behavior; informal and often disapproving.

senses.m: Dishonest, suspicious, or silly behavior
senses.pat: no monkey business · suspect monkey business · get up to monkey business
ex: The auditor found no monkey business in the accounts.
Kiểm toán viên không phát hiện hành vi gian lận trong sổ sách.
The teacher warned the class to stop the monkey business.
Giáo viên cảnh báo cả lớp ngừng nghịch ngợm.

note: A peanut, especially in British English; the edible seed grows underground and is not a true nut botanically.

senses.m: A peanut, especially in British English
senses.pat: a packet of monkey nuts · shell monkey nuts · monkey-nut allergy
ex: He bought roasted monkey nuts at the market.
Anh mua đậu phộng rang ở chợ.
The label warns that the snack contains peanuts.
Nhãn cảnh báo món ăn vặt có chứa đậu phộng.

note: A climbing plant with trumpet-shaped flowers, often in the genus Ipomoea; some species are invasive or have psychoactive seeds. Also a breakfast pastry in some regions.

senses.m: A climbing plant with trumpet-shaped flowers, often in the genus Ipomoea
senses.pat: morning-glory flowers · grow morning glory on a trellis · a morning-glory vine
ex: Purple morning glory opened along the fence.
Hoa bìm bìm tím nở dọc hàng rào.
The gardener removed the invasive morning-glory vine.
Người làm vườn loại bỏ dây bìm bìm xâm lấn.
